To which of the given options is 70 related, following the same logic?(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. In this question, a statement is given followed by two courses of action, numbered I and II. You must assume everything in the statement to be true, and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which of the given courses of action logically follow(s) for pursuing.Statement: The India Meteorological Department has predicted heavy to very heavy rainfall in parts of southern India during the next 48 hours due to a cyclonic circulation.Courses of Action:I. The administration should advice all the establishments, EXCEPT the emergency services, to shut for the next 48 hours.II. The administration should activate its disaster management team to tackle any emergency situation.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Both I and II follow) है।

A # B means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

In this question, a statement is given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true and decide which of them logically follow(s) beyond a reasonable doubt from the information given in the statement.Statement:Without any natural calamity, damages and cracks are seen on a newly constructed building in the neighbourhood X.Conclusions:I) All buildings in the neighbourhood X have similar cracks and damage. II) Strict building regulations in neighbourhood X have enabled such damages and cracks in the building.
options: Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.
Both Conclusions I and II follow.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.) है।
